attack: sweep（普通攻击，镇魇白虎 Boss）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright white tiger warrior in the reference performs ONE ordinary claw sweep attack in place. From the resting pose it crouches slightly and draws the right clawed arm back behind the shoulder, then makes one fast strong diagonal claw swipe forward and down toward screen left, follows through, then lowers the arm and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. Exactly two arms and two legs. Keep the same three-quarter left view, white tiger head, white and black striped fur, silver hair, armor, belt and kilt. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No walking, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon, claw trails, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: draw back over the first second, the swipe happens quickly around one and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
